p: sons of Judah: Meaning, they came from Judah, as nephews and kinsmen: for only Pharez was his natural son.
firstborn of Ephratah: The first born of his mother, and not the eldest of his father.
that thine hand might be with: It is to be understood that then he would accomplish his vow which he made.
father of the valley of Charashim: The Lord of the valley where the artificers worked.
there they dwelt with the king: They were David's gardeners and served him in his works.
Shaul: His son Obed is omitted here.
Beersheba: These cities belonged to Judah, Jos 19:2, and were given to the tribe of Simeon.
David: Then David restored them to the tribe of Judah.
went to the entrance of Gedor: For the tribe of Simeon was so great in number, that in the time of Hezekiah they sought new dwellings to Gedor, which is in the tribe of Dan.
escaped: And were not slain by Saul and David.
